fusions.name: Crossed Purposes
fusions.desc: Throws a gust around up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, dealing 10 damage to each and knocking them back 2.5 tiles, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Whispered Feint
fusions.desc: Flicks a puff of razor air at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance to turn the target against its allies for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone Unscented
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds, during which you move 20% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Never Quite There
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow you failed to dodge rolls your dodge a second time, and the second roll stands.
